CHANGELOG updated in BURROW: Phase 3 (region analyzer) + Phase 4 (v0 C emitter) shipped: region.go/emit_c.go, faithful ports of PARENA/src/region.c + narrow-v0 emit_ts.c/emit_java.c-style C emitter. 30 real ported assertions + 8 new emit_c tests, 38/38 total. Real bug found+fixed: unrecognized math/* identifiers were silently emitted as broken C -- now a real, honest 'unknown identifier' error matching parena-c's own behavior exactly. Real end-to-end proof: burrow build -> gcc -> level_mod_test.c's own assertions, all pass. main.go's parse/analyze/build subcommands now do real work. burrow installed on PATH. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
